name: Quick Pickled Red Onions
ingredients:
1 red onion, thinly sliced
1/2 cup cider vinegar
1/2 cup water
1 TBSP sugar
1 1/2 tsp salt
directions:
Pack the onion into a jar.
Bring the vinegar, water, sugar and salt to a simmer, stirring until dissolved, and pour it over the onion.
Cool, then chill for at least an hour.
